sections.label: Pallavi
sections.ta:
சரவண பவ குஹனே சண்முகனே
சங்கரி மைந்தனே சடாக்ஷரனே
sections.translit:
saravaNa bhava guhanE saNmuganE
sangkari maindhanE satAksharanE
sections.en: Lord Saravanabhava, you possess six faces and are known as Sanmugan. You are also known as Guha and you live in the hearts of your devotees. You are the son of Goddess Parvathi and reside in the six syllables Sa Ra Va Na Ba vA.

sections.label: Anupallavi
sections.ta:
ஏறுமயில் ஏறிடும் ஆறுமுகனே பெரும்
பேறு தரும் செந்தில் சிங்கார வேலனே
sections.translit:
ERumayil ERidum ARumuganE perum
pERu tharum sendhil singAra vElanE
sections.en: Lord Arumuga, you are mounted on a beautiful peacock. Oh, handsome Lord Muruga of Thiruchendur, you offer abundant blessings to your devotees.

sections.label: Charanam
sections.ta:
உனை நினைந்துருகாத உள்ளமும்
உலகினில் உண்டோ இலையென்பது உண்மையன்றோ
தஞ்சமென்ற என் நெஞ்சினில் வந்திடு
அஞ்சேல் என்றே அருள் தந்திடு
sections.translit:
unai ninaindhurugAdha uLLamum
ulaginil uNdO ilaiyenbadhu uNmaiyandRO
thanjamendRa en nenjinil vandhidu
anjEl endRE aruL thandhidu
sections.en: Is there a heart in this world that does not soften when thinking about you? I am seeking refuge at your feet. Please come and dwell in my heart and offer me your grace with assuring words of protection.

notes: This song was written for the Bharatanatyam dancer, Smt. Subhashini Srinath of Fremont, CA to teach to her young students.  "Guhai" translates to "cave" in Tamil. The deity Muruga is known as "Guha" because it is believed he lives in the hearts of his devotees, as though in a cave. The name Saravanabava reveals the origin of Lord Muruga. Agni carried Siva’s sparks and deposited them in the Ganges River near a cluster of reeds or a bamboo bush. The name is a combination of three Sanskrit words, Sara (reed or dharba), vana (forest), and uthbhava (born of). This cluster of reeds lived in the mythical pond called Saravana Poigai in Tamil. The anupallavi phrase “ஏறுமயில் ஏறிடும்" refers to Muruga mounted on a male peacock or  his war vehicle (as ஏறுமயில் has multiple meanings).
